segments.ja: 地下室の本は、シガンシナの診療から始まりません。始まらない最初の頁は、壁の外の港です。港の国の名を、本はマーレと書きます。マーレは、壁の中の教育に存在しない国です。存在しない国で、グリシャは子供でした。子供の父は、壁の医者になる前に、別の人生を持っていました。持っていた人生を、エレンは今日、字で追います。追う字が、あの日の入口です。
segments.en: The book in the basement does not begin at the clinic in Shiganshina. The first page that does not begin is a port outside the walls. The book writes the name of the country of the port as Marley. Marley is a country that does not exist in the education inside the walls. In the country that does not exist, Grisha was a child. Before becoming the doctor of the walls, the father of the child had another life. Eren follows today in handwriting the life he had. The handwriting he follows is the entrance of that day.

The loss has the shape of being taken away by Titans.

segments.en: Grisha's younger sister goes outside the internment zone and does not come back. Marley disposes of the reason she does not come back with eaten by dogs. The father does not believe the words that dispose of it. The child who does not believe is the later Grisha. The later father begins the anger outside the walls from this loss. Eren looks at the anger he begins, laid over his own anger. The laying over he looks at is not exact. Even not exact, one end of the reason his father stayed silent inside the walls is visible. That visible end sits under the clinic's kindness.

The punishment of being made is the collapse of that day. After the collapse, the father is sent inside the walls. The method of being sent is carried by the next episode of the Attack Titan. Before it carries it, only the brother's name remains.

segments.titleEn: Dina is a Pure Titan inside the walls
segments.ja: 本は、ダイナが無垢の巨人にされたあと、壁の中の側へ流されたことを示唆します。示唆する巨人は、エレンが初めて見た、母を食べた巨人と重なる可能性があります。可能性を、この回は断定しません。断定しない理由は、頁が顔の一致をまだ一行では書かない、です。書かない一致を、エレンは自分の記憶で恐れて見ます。見る恐れは、母の死が父の過去の続きかもしれない、です。かもしれない痛みが、あの日の一番深い段です。
segments.en: The book suggests that after Dina was made into a Pure Titan, she was swept toward the inside of the walls. The Titan it suggests may overlap the Titan Eren saw first, the one that ate his mother. This episode does not assert the possibility. The reason it does not assert it is that the page does not yet write the match of the face in one line. Eren looks in fear, with his own memory, at the match that is not written. The fear he looks at is that his mother's death may be a continuation of his father's past. That pain is the deepest step of that day.
